title: Active Data Sampling and Generation for Bias Remediation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the ratio of male and female predictions in a visual semantic role labeling task using the imSitu dataset. The methodology involves artificially inducing controlled gender imbalances (e.g., 90/10, 80/20) for certain verbs like 'cooking', applying a reverse-biased active sampling strategy ('samplation') during fine-tuning, and measuring whether the resulting male-to-female prediction ratio on the test set reaches a perfectly balanced target value of 1.
